exposure: Regional social-economic level (median GDP per capita)
outcome: Proportion of HOT use at discharge
cohort: The study included 1768 preterm infants at gestational ages < 32 weeks, with a birth weight < 1500 g, and with moderate or severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) who survived to discharge from tertiary hospitals in 25 provinces.
finding: The use of home oxygen therapy (HOT) varied significantly across China and was negatively correlated with the levels of provincial economic development.
